## 游戏内容介绍


扳击锤、扣扳机、数到六，退弹壳、再数到六：深度的手动装填系统，下潜深渊射击可理解的恐怖，躲开不可理解的恐怖。「If Darkwood was on DOS」。

### Steam 商店简介（原文摘录）〔Steam商店页〕

> Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

>  You hold death in your hands, and death is heavy. Heavy in the Hand is a top-down action horror game that puts the weight of the action directly into the player's hands. Key Features Deep and Satisfying Reload System Ammo Management and Difficult Choices Stylized Low-Resolution Pixel-Art A Gothic Horror Story A Shooting Range With Custom Challenges for Each Gun Puzzles, Secrets, and Collectables
